name: Wathlingen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Wathlingen (crossed hammers, ears of wheat and a pot on green).
history: Hammer and mallet symbolise mining and salt extraction; the banner consists of two equal stripes, green and gold, with the arms shifted upward.

features.role: Wathlingen arms — hammers, ears and pot on green
